meta.title: 2026 AI and AI-adjacent funding rounds
meta.coverage: 1 January - 7 August 2026. Rounds of roughly $100M+ plus a small number of sub-$100M rounds flagged as frontier bets. Not exhaustive: assembled from published monthly and weekly roundups, so rounds that were never covered by those sources are missing.
meta.currency: amount_usd_m and valuation_usd_m are USD millions. Non-USD rounds are converted at approximately 7.1 CNY/USD and 1.09 USD/EUR and are marked approximate in the amount field.
sources: AlleyWatch monthly global and US roundups (data via Crunchbase)
Crunchbase News monthly and weekly roundups
meta.caveat: Every figure is press-reported and not independently verified. Where sources disagree, the conflict is recorded in the note field and in the conflicts log on the page.
